name: quiche
description: 🥧 Savoury implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
one_liner: A low-level engineering library that implements the newest, faster internet protocol (QUIC/HTTP-3) that services like Cloudflare use to move web traffic faster.
buyer: An infrastructure engineer at a networking or CDN company who needs a proven, battle-tested QUIC implementation instead of writing one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A CDN or edge-networking startup embeds it to add HTTP/3 support to their proxy or load balancer.
A mobile app company uses it to speed up API calls over unreliable networks via QUIC's faster connection setup.
A networking consultancy offers 'add HTTP/3 support' as a paid upgrade for clients' existing infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Offer contract engineering to integrate quiche into a client's existing proxy, CDN, or mobile SDK.

steal_this: There isn't a real weekend consumer product here; this is foundational networking plumbing. Honest take: valuable to know about, not something to flip into a business this weekend.
